title: Azure Network Security Groups
text: A Network Security Group, or NSG, contains access control rules that allow or deny inbound and outbound network traffic to Azure resources. NSGs can be associated with subnets and network interfaces.

title: Terraform Infrastructure as Code
text: Terraform is an infrastructure as code tool. Configuration files describe desired infrastructure resources and Terraform calculates a plan before applying changes.

title: Kubernetes Deployments
text: A Kubernetes Deployment manages a set of replicated Pods and provides declarative updates. Deployments can perform rolling updates and maintain the desired replica count.

title: Docker Containers
text: A Docker container is an isolated process created from an image. Containers package an application and its runtime dependencies and can be run consistently across environments.

title: RAG Retrieval
text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation retrieves relevant documents from an external knowledge source and supplies those documents to a language model as context before answer generation.
